about: A has guard short-circuits, so a condition on a missing attribute neither errors nor applies.
laws:
laws "conformance" version 1

law reads
  says  "reads"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Doc
  permit
  evidence watched

law guard
  says  "guard"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Doc
  forbid when resource has missing && resource.missing == 1
  evidence watched
